@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3A1QAFD56F5TEPPADDJHENH
+- 01M3A1QND68R1PN6K74Z6AV3EP
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'Add a disk tier to ExecutorPromptCacheStore: spill on eviction, find on a memory miss, limit by bytes and age'
+---
+#prompt-cache
+
+## What
+
+In `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCache.swift`, give `ExecutorPromptCacheStore` an optional disk tier. With no disk configuration, the store works as the byte-limited memory tier of task ^ddjhenh, and writes no file.
+
+Configuration (internal type in this task; the API task makes it public):
+```swift
+struct ExecutorPromptCacheDiskConfiguration: Sendable {
+    enum Location: Sendable {
+        /// All files in one directory. The store scans it at configure time.
+        case directory(URL)
+        /// The host gives one directory for each session. The store knows only
+        /// the files it wrote or read in this process.
+        case perSession(@Sendable (_ modelID: String, _ sessionID: String) -> URL)
+    }
+    var location: Location
+    var byteLimit: Int          // total bytes of files the store knows
+    var maximumAge: Duration?   // files older than this are deleted
+}
+```
+
+Behavior:
+- `spill(_:_:)` (the one eviction path from ^ddjhenh) writes the entry with `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.write` (task ^z6av3ep) to `directory(for: key)/fileName(for: key)`, when a disk tier is set. The write must not block the actor for its whole length: move the entry to `pendingWrites[key]`, run the write in a detached task, and on completion move the key to the disk index `diskIndex[key] = (url, byteCount, lastUse)`. A write that throws deletes the partial file and drops the entry, and logs one line.
+- `checkOut` returns `enum ExecutorPromptCacheCheckout { case memory(ExecutorPromptCacheEntry), disk(URL), none }`. Order: memory entry → pending write (return the entry in memory as `.memory`, and cancel the effect of the write: its completion must not add the key to the disk index) → disk index → for `.perSession`, a file that exists at the resolved path (after a restart the index is empty) → `.none`. A `.disk` check-out removes the key from the disk index. The caller reads the file and deletes it after a successful read (task: executor wiring).
+- `checkIn` of a key deletes any disk file of that key, because the entry in memory is newer.
+- Disk limit: after each index change, delete least-recently-used files until the known total is at or below `byteLimit`, and delete files older than `maximumAge`.
+- `evict(modelID:)` and a new `evict(sessionID:)` (all models) delete the memory entries, pending writes and files of the matching keys. For `.perSession`, `evict(sessionID:)` also deletes the file at the resolved path of each known model id.
+- Add `func persistAll() async` — writes every memory entry to disk and waits until all writes end, for a host that shuts down and wants to restart warm. The entries stay in memory.
+- The arrays of an entry must be evaluated before the write starts, thus the write copies data and runs no graph. Call `eval` on the arrays in `spill` before the detached write (they are normally already evaluated by generation).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With a disk tier, an entry evicted by bytes is on disk, and a later `checkOut` of that key returns `.disk(url)` and not `.none`.
+- [ ] A `checkOut` while the write of the same key still runs returns `.memory` with the same entry, and after the write ends, no disk index entry and no file remain for that key.
+- [ ] `checkIn` of a key removes that key's older file.
+- [ ] The disk byte limit and the maximum age delete files, least recently used first.
+- [ ] `.directory` scans existing files at configure time, and a new store instance (a simulated restart) returns `.disk` for a file an earlier instance wrote.
+- [ ] `.perSession` finds a file at the resolved path after a simulated restart.
+- [ ] `evict(sessionID:)` removes memory, pending and disk state of that session, for all models; `evict(modelID:)` for one model.
+- [ ] `persistAll()` returns after every file exists.
+- [ ] With no disk tier, no file is written (behavior equals ^ddjhenh).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ExecutorPromptCacheDiskTierTests.swift` with one test for each criterion above. Create a new `ExecutorPromptCacheStore()` instance for each test (not `.shared`) and a temporary directory. For the in-flight write case, inject a slow writer (an internal writer closure the tests can replace).
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest` — all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
